virals_narrative: Codie Sanchez led again: the paper-mail story (a $50 printer to almost $60K a month) reached 85.9K in about 21 hours and 'buying time' passed 147K. Arvid Kahl's 'they sell stability' SaaS post reached 9.2K and Tony Dinh's Stripe Residency post 5.1K. Square, Shopify and Pat Walls posted no originals in the window. No niche vendor post cleared 5K; artist alley table prices were the busiest vendor topic. Competitors HipopMarkets, BoothKeeper and BuildersBenchRe posted nothing in the last ~26h.
